changes.reason: Fact History excludes a superseded row when its correction is known, including effective times outside the corrected interval. The evaluator uses the existing append-only history.

kubernetes.reason: Supersession uses the rows loaded by the existing store and has no dependency on Node host capabilities, storage changes or deployment lifecycle.

aws-lambda.reason: The evaluator runs on the returned history rows and has no dependency on Lambda invocation, connection or flush lifecycle.

cloudflare.reason: The evaluator uses only the provided history rows and timestamps. It requires no Workers binding, container or runtime API.
